hook.line: Five secret Claude codes nobody is talking about
hook.visual: Blank light grid, then '5 SECRET' types in at 0.38 s, an orange Claude asterisk drops in, a blurred old key slides in at the bottom and a black 'nobody is talking about' label stamps on by 1.88 s

beats.what: Kinetic title '5 SECRET Claude codes' builds word by word on a grey grid
Code 1 '/ghost': a prompt box with a dotted line to a '/ghost' tag
Big '#2' numeral with black starburst shapes sliding in from corners
A Claude answer card scrolls down a grey column for 'every angle'
'#3 /buddha' with a zoom punch on the numeral
Keyword chips ('just clear', 'step-by-step actions') stack in, 'RIGHT NOW' in caps
Code 4 '/l99' tag at the end of a prompt box, 'EXPERT MODE' in big type
'#5' numeral, then a long answer card scrolls for 'god mode'
Lead magnet: 'Comment HUMAN' with a 3D ebook cover
Brand crown logo and 'follow' instruction on a dark end frame

why_it_works: Numbered list promise (5 codes) gives a progress bar in the viewer's head, so they stay to reach #5
Each code gets the same three-step rhythm (big numeral, slash-command tag on a prompt box, one-line payoff), so new items are easy to follow at 3 words/s
Comment-keyword lead magnet ('HUMAN' for the ebook) turns the end into comments and follows
Only 3 cuts in 61 s; motion comes from type and shapes animating in, which feels premium without footage
weaknesses: No face, so there is no person to trust; claims about 'secret codes' go unproven
The answer cards are too small to read, so the 'proof' is only decoration
Loop score is low (0.47): the dark follow frame does not lead back to the start
for_robert: Use the repeating per-item template (numeral, the exact command on a tag, one-line payoff) for list reels, with Fred carrying each numbered tag in; avoid unreadable screenshot 'proof'.
